summary: Local-first multilingual learning app for grade-school learners, combining Filipino, English, and Hiligaynon practice with accessible learning flows, parent progress insights, and no feature paywalls.
status: Language-learning MVP scope, learner flows, progress analytics, accessibility requirements, and provenance-aware content validation foundations are defined and under active implementation.
next: Continue frontend integration, canonical content validation, local progress persistence, sound and visual feedback, and progressive 3D study-buddy exploration.
